source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    # The repeated full-width/full-height lines mark the panel boundaries.
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panel_rows = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1) if row_bounds[i + 1] > row_bounds[i] + 1]
    panel_cols = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1) if col_bounds[i + 1] > col_bounds[i] + 1]
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    bg = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in panel_rows:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in panel_cols:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if count >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
